newsitem.title: USA: Capstar to acquire Gulfstar Communications.
newsitem.headline: Capstar to acquire Gulfstar Communications.

text.p: Capstar Broadcasting Partners said Tuesday that it will acquire Gulfstar Communications Inc, the largest owner of radio stations in the Southwestern United States, in a transaction that will create a company with an enterprise value of more than $1 billion.
Both companies are base in Austin, Texas.

Capstar is a radio broadcasting company formed in May 1996 by Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc of Dallas, a leading private investment firm, and R. Steven Hicks, Capstar's president and chief executive officer.
Capstar said the all-stock transaction is subject to regulatory approval and the completion of the previously announced initial public stock offering by Capstar.

The combination of Capstar with Gulfstar, which was formed in 1992 by Hicks and his brother, Thomas Hicks, brings to 229 the number of stations Capstar will have upon completion of all announced transactions, Capstar said.
